yūkā: [Yū+ka+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Yotī(yavatī)ti yūkā, yūko vā. Kappadduma.(thī,pu)yūka-saṃ. Jūā-prā.] Louse (It is being on the body of cat, dog, mouse , which is Cat"s louse, dog"s louse, mouse louse etc.,).
yūpa: [Yu+pa] (pu) CL=7 [Yumissane, po, dīghādi. Dhāna, ṭī. 290. Yūpa+ṇa. Samussitaṭṭhena yūpoviyāti yūpo, yūpanti(yavanti,)etthasatthā aneka bhūmikūṭāgārovara-kādivantatāyāti yūpo, pāsādo. Dī, ṭī, 3. 33. Yavanti sahavattanti etthāti yūpo. Ṇvādi. 115. Yavati missayatīti yūpo, kappadduma. Yūpa-saṃ. Jūa-prā.] (1) sacrificial post, The post on which tie animals to offer a sacrifice. (2) Many-tiered. (3) One who likes the sacrificial post. (One who is famous in all three worlds). See original.
yūpattha: [Yūpa+attha] (pu) CL=7 The benefit which is sacrificial post.
yūpussana: [Yūpa+ussana] (na) CL=7 A place where sets up the sacrificial post.
yūpussāpana: [Yūpa+ussāpana] (na) CL=7 It is erected like sacrificial post.
yūsa: [Yūsa+a] (a) CL=7 [Yūpa-saṃ. Jasa-prā.] (1) liquid, Sanaṃrañña, Liqid come out from sore. (2) Boiled bean liquid. (3) Soup, Rice porride/Rice gruel. (4) Blood. (5) Marrow, Oil. See original.
yūsagata: [Yūsa+gata] (ti) CL=7 Which is inclusived in many kinds of liquid, It is reached to the state of liquid.
yūsamakkhita: [Yūsa+makkhita] (ti) CL=7 Should be applied with dirt and gleet;discharge from wound (Sanaṃrañña).
yūsākāra: [Yūsā+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The nature of things which is liquid.
yūtha: (Na) [yū+tha.yavati missībhavatīti yūtho. Nīti,sutta. 334-nhaṅa့dhāna. 632.J It has like that masculine gender. Yūtha-saṃ. Jūha-prā.] All of (animals which are members of the same caste). Group, Association, Sect (or) Herd (same race animals).
yūthacara: [Yūtha+cara+a.yūthacārina-saṃ.] (ti) CL=7 who are wondering with groups.
yūthajeṭṭha: [Yūtha+jeṭṭha] (ti) CL=7 Elephants King (Who is the chief of elephants).
yūthanissaṭa: [Yūtha+nissaṭa] (ti) CL=7 One who is going away from group.
yūthapa: [Yūtha+pā+a] (pu) CL=7 [Sayūthe pātirakkhatīti yūthapo. Dhāna, ṭī. 360. Yūthaṃpātirakkhatīti yūthapo. Kappadduma.] (1) King of elephants ( who is master of elephants). (2) Monkey King ( who is chief of monkeys.)
yūthaparihīna: [Yūtha+parihīna] (ti) CL=7 who is separated form deer group.
yūthapariṇāyaka: [Yūtha+pariṇāyaka] (ti) CL=7 It is the chief of oxes (leading bull of the herd).
yūthapati: [Yūtha+pati] (pu) CL=7 [Yūthapati-saṃ. Jūhavai-prā.] (1) King of elephants ( it is the leader of elephants). (2) King of oxes ( it is the chief of oxes). (3) King of monkeys (it is the leader of monkeys). (4) King of deers (it is the chief of deers).
yūthapatiputta: [Yūthapati+putta] (pu) CL=7 Son of the Monkey King.
yūthika: [Yūthikā+a] (pu) CL=7 A Thera who donated Jasmine flowers, Jvana flowers (small fragrant white flower Jasminum auriculatum).
yūthikapupphiya: [Yūthikapupphi+iya] (ti) CL=7 One who is offering Jasmine flowers, Jvana flowers (small fragrant white flower Jasminum auriculatum).
yūthikā: [Yūtha+i+ka+ā.dvayaṃcammeya] (thī) CL=7 [Iti khyāte. Yūtha hiṃsāyaṃ, sāyaṃ, isakatthe ko, dīghādi. Dhāna, ṭī. 576. Yūthaṃ puppharāsi assā atthītiyūthikā. Yūtha+ika. Kappadduma. Yūthikā-saṃ. Jūtiyā-prā] Jasmine plant, Jasmine flowers, Jvana flowers (small fragrant white flower Jasminum auriculatum).
yūthikāpuppha: [Yūthikā+puppha] (na) CL=7 Jasmine flowers, Jvana flowers (small fragrant white flower Jasminum auriculatum).
